1.Nf3 d5 2.c4 e6 3.b3 Nf6 4.Bb2 c5 5.e3.strategy: Modest and solid: it opens the f1-bishop and covers d4, without blocking the b2-bishop's diagonal. White gives up the central pawn break for now, so Black can take the initiative with a free hand in the centre.
1.Nf3 d5 2.c4 e6 3.b3 Nf6 4.Bb2 c5 5.e3.name: English Opening: Agincourt Defence, Wimpy System
